target.title: fix(discord): guard message handler against malformed gateway dispatch data
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The Discord message handler in `extensions/discord/src/monitor/message-handler.ts` accesses `entry.data` properties without optional chaining, risking crashes at runtime when the gateway dispatches malformed or incomplete data.

## Why This Change Was Made

A defensive programming audit identified 4 locations in the message handler where `entry.data` or `last.data` are accessed without null safety:

1. **`buildKey` callback**: `entry.data.message` and `entry.data.channel_id` are accessed without accounting for `entry.data` being undefined.
2. **`onFlush` combined text builder**: `entry.data.message` in a `.map()` callback — any single entry with missing data crashes the entire flush.
3. **`onFlush` synthetic message**: `last.data.message` is used as argument to `Object.create`/`Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptors` — both throw on null/undefined.

## User Impact

Without these guards, a single malformed gateway dispatch event can crash the entire Discord message processing pipeline, causing message loss and requiring a gateway restart.

## Evidence

### Fix summary (4 guards added)

| Location | Change | Protection |
|----------|--------|-----------|
| `buildKey` entry.data access | `entry.data.message` → `entry.data?.message` | Graceful skip of malformed entries |
| `buildKey` channel_id access | `entry.data.channel_id` → `entry.data?.channel_id` | Graceful skip of entries without channel |
| combined text builder | `entry.data.message` → guarded `entry.data?.message` | Null entries filtered out, not crashing |
| synthetic message | Added `if (!last.data?.message) return` | Early return prevents `Object.create(null)` crash |

### Tests

All 1825+ existing Discord extension tests pass (160 test files), including all `message-handler.*` preflight and bot-self-filter tests.
